title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Researcher reports export to PowerPoint, PDF, Infographic and Audio Overview
summary: Hold: the Copilot Pages automation is presented as group-scoped, but Microsoft says it works only with tenant-level policies and fails when the setting exists in a group policy. The page also omits qualifications on Pages creation and Researcher session access, and does not establish that the package-block API implements Researcher's tenant-wide Block action.

claims.where: controls[1].api and scope; Governance controls table
claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors applies the Pages control with the group scope shown in the row.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.
claims.fix: Keep the API call, set controls[1].scope to 'other', and qualify the note with 'UI: all users or a group. API: tenant-level policies only; the operation fails if this setting is configured in any group-level policy. The request body sets mode to applyOnce and supplies baseline.resources with resourceType microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion 1 and properties.value "0" to disable.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources for this qualification.
